description: Wait until a research project needs the user or has finished (its state is no longer queued or working), up to wait_seconds, then say where it stands as get_project does. Free. If it is still working, call it again with the after_seq it returns.

after_seq.description: The after_seq the last call returned (start_project, message_project, act_on_project or this)

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait (default 55, at most 240)

name: wait_for_project
title: Wait for a research project
